relationships.subject: spinal alpha7nAChR
relationships.evidence_quote: This suggests that spinal α7nAChR mediates BDNF/TrkB-KCC2 signaling pathway and plays a role in PSD-induced postoperative hyperalgesia.

key_findings: 24 h preoperative paradoxical sleep deprivation aggravated incision-induced hyperalgesia in rats, decreased spinal alpha7nAChR and KCC2 and increased BDNF and TrkB; intrathecal alpha-bungarotoxin worsened all of these.
2/100 Hz EA at Zusanli/Baihui raised spinal alpha7nAChR and KCC2, lowered BDNF/TrkB and relieved hyperalgesia, effects reversed by alpha-bungarotoxin.
